svg.title: Flats 9-weight, wind — leader diagram
svg.desc: Leader schematic for Flats 9-weight, wind: 4 ft · 40 lb Hard mono butt, then 1.5 ft · 30 lb Hard mono, then 1 ft · 25 lb Hard mono, then 1 ft · 20 lb Hard mono, then 1.5 ft · 16 lb Fluorocarbon tippet.
svg.text: When: Moderate to strong wind, bigger flies, permit, or
albacore. A shorter leader turns over when a long one will not.
Not to scale — lengths are on the labels.
